questions.explanation: Use 'for' with a period of time (five years) and 'since' with a starting point.

wrongReasons.0: 'since' needs a starting point, such as 2019.
wrongReasons.2: With 'since' or 'for' + a period we use the present perfect, not the present simple.

options: I have lived here since five years.
I have lived here for five years.
I live here since five years.

questions.explanation: First conditional: if + present simple, will + base verb.

wrongReasons.0: Do not use 'would' in the if-clause of a first conditional.
wrongReasons.2: Do not use 'will' in the if-clause.

options: If I would have time, I will help you.
If I have time, I will help you.
If I will have time, I help you.
